description.value:
Frequency once per week

Requirement The target has a Scar you can work on.

Cost 2 Vitae

Spend a day of downtime and 2 Vitae reworking a Scar into something closer to fair. Choose one Scar the target carries and replace it with a Minor mutation of the same Slot, chosen by the same rules Marrow Deep would use. The Scar's old Tithe and thin Gift are both gone, replaced entirely by the new Minor entry's own Gift and Tithe.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Also This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. -- Scar/Tithe/Gift replacement is entirely homebrew and can target a patient other than the caster.
